title: Valuation Summary (levers)
description: Machine-readable valuation LEVERS emitted by 99_valuation-synthesis alongside its markdown, so the fair value is re-derivable and the cockpit Playground has inputs to move. It carries INPUTS (per-scenario forward metric + multiple, WACC components, shares, net-debt basis, price) — the counterpart to decision_record.json, which carries the master synthesizer's scenario OUTPUTS (probabilities + returns). The module does NOT assign scenario probabilities (that boundary belongs to the master synthesizer, MODULE_RULES Scope), so `probability` is optional here; the Playground reads probabilities from decision_record.json. Consumed by scripts/valuation_math.py (recompute / reanchor) and the /api/valuation-levers endpoint.

business_type.description: Operating / Financial / REIT / Commodity / Holding (Business-Type Method Map)

basis.description: equity = per-share metric x equity multiple (P/E on EPS); ev = total metric x EV multiple, bridged by net_debt/shares

shares.description: diluted shares for the EV->equity per-share bridge (basis='ev')

net_debt.description: canonical net-debt anchor: positive = debt, negative = net cash (subtracted in the bridge)

probability.description: OPTIONAL — the master synthesizer owns probabilities (decision_record.json); omit or null here

forward_metric.description: forward EPS (basis=equity) or forward EBITDA/EBIT total (basis=ev)

level.description: the derived per-share fair-value LEVEL (= metric x multiple, bridged for basis='ev'); price-independent

drivers.description: one line: the operating drivers behind this case

methods.description: cross-method football field {own_history, peers, dcf, sotp: per-share value or null}

method_weights.description: effective base-point weights per method (multiples-first policy)

is_developed_mega_cap.description: enables the Gate-4 developed-market mega-cap cost-of-equity ceiling

dcf_grid.description: v1.1 (P-C sub-levers) — the DCF orb's OWN recorded WACC × terminal-growth sensitivity grid (04_intrinsic-dcf §7), transcribed verbatim so the Playground can derive the DCF method value from typed WACC/growth fields. Values between recorded points are linear blends of these cells (labelled interpolated); outside the grid is flagged extrapolated. The cell at `base` MUST equal methods.dcf — the grid reproduces the recorded method value, never a new model.

wacc.description: ascending WACC column points, as decimals (0.075 = 7.5%)

growth.description: ascending terminal-growth row points, as decimals

values.description: per-share values: values[growthIdx][waccIdx], matching the orb's own table cells

base.description: the orb's used WACC/growth pair — its grid cell equals methods.dcf

sotp_segments.description: v1.1 (P-C sub-levers) — the SOTP orb's OWN per-segment metric × multiple rows (06_sum-of-the-parts), transcribed verbatim so each segment multiple is a typed lever. Σ(metric × multiple) + sotp_bridge must reproduce methods.sotp through the shares bridge.

metric_name.description: e.g. 'LTM Adj. EBITDA' — the basis the multiple applies to

metric.description: the segment metric value (company currency, millions)

comp.description: the named comparable behind the multiple

sotp_bridge.description: v1.1 — the recorded EV→equity bridge for the SOTP re-sum: per-share = (Σ segment EVs − net_debt − minority + other) / shares (top-level `shares`). Amounts in company currency, millions; positive values are subtracted for net_debt/minority, added for `other`.

other.description: net other bridge items (+ additions, − subtractions), 0/null when none

peers_internals.description: v1.1 (P-C sub-levers) — the peers orb's OWN implied-value line (03_relative-valuation-peers §5): two verbatim anchor rows (multiple → per-share value) define the affine map the Playground moves along; the lever is the discount % off the peer median. anchors[0] at applied_multiple must equal methods.peers.

applied_multiple.description: the multiple the base case used (median × (1 − discount))

discount_pct.description: the recorded quality discount off the median, in percent (10 = 10%)

anchors.description: verbatim rows from the orb's implied-value table; the client interpolates linearly through them
